question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Advocate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Advocate **means to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy. (किसी विशेष कारण या नीति का सार्वजनिक रूप से समर्थन या अनुशंसा करना)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
 
 
• **Example**: *She advocates for animal rights and regularly donates to animal shelters.*</
